sections.title: Comparing without a special ending
sections.content: olyan ("such, that kind of") plus mint ("like, as") lets you compare two things without needing a whole new grammatical form — just two small words wrapped around what you're comparing.

items.spanish: A kollégám olyan türelmes, mint Anna.
items.english: My colleague is as patient as Anna.

sections.content: You'll meet a dedicated comparative ending later (-bb, "more/-er") much further into A2 — for now, olyan... mint already lets you compare people and things without waiting for it.
